categories.main_business_segments: Jiayu Holding Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: the new energy sector, including high-efficiency photovoltaic (PV) module research, design, production, sales, and PV and wind power EPC projects, as well as solar thermal and clean heating systems; and the building decoration sector, focusing on energy-saving doors, windows, and curtain wall products, including production, construction, and retail services for various building types.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced photovoltaic technologies such as PERC, TOPCon, and HJT cells, with automated production lines capable of manufacturing various PV module types including large-size, multi-busbar, bifacial, and building-integrated PV (BIPV) modules. It also develops solar thermal heating systems integrating solar heat with auxiliary energy sources. The EPC projects follow a comprehensive project management system with four-in-one control over design, procurement, production, and construction, adhering to national quality and safety standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government entities, state-owned enterprises, large real estate developers, and residential and commercial building owners. The new energy business serves clients in the solar and wind power sectors, including national grid companies and energy investment firms. The building decoration segment targets public buildings, high-end offices, hotels, and residential projects. The company’s geographic focus includes northern and western China, with significant projects in provinces like Liaoning, Gansu, Ningxia, and regions such as Northeast and Northwest China.
categories.geographic_coverage: Jiayu Holding operates mainly within China, with significant presence in Northeast and Northwest regions, including Liaoning, Gansu, Ningxia, and Hebei provinces. It also has a wholly-owned subsidiary in Singapore for overseas operations. The company’s projects and sales cover major Chinese regions including North China, South China, East China, and others, with a strong concentration in the Northwest region.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the photovoltaic and building decoration supply chains. It manufactures PV modules and solar thermal products (midstream) and provides EPC contracting services for solar and wind power projects, as well as construction and installation services for doors, windows, and curtain walls (downstream).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on expanding the new energy business as the main growth driver, accelerating product upgrades such as large-size and multi-busbar PV modules, and enhancing EPC project capabilities. R&D efforts concentrate on improving PV conversion efficiency, reducing costs, and developing integrated solar thermal heating solutions tailored for northern China. The company also aims to optimize management structures, strengthen risk control, and improve asset liquidity to support sustainable development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of photovoltaic modules, solar thermal heating systems, and building decoration products, as well as through EPC contracting services for solar and wind power projects and construction projects in the building decoration sector. The company also earns income from leasing properties and other non-core business activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jiayu Holding is positioned as a leading player in China's photovoltaic and building decoration industries, recognized for its comprehensive PV module production and EPC capabilities and as a top brand in the door and curtain wall sector. It competes with other major PV manufacturers and EPC contractors in China, facing intense market competition and industry consolidation. The company holds multiple industry certifications and has contributed to national standards, enhancing its competitive standing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported a significant revenue decline of approximately 60% to 482 million RMB, primarily due to judicial restructuring and operational challenges. Net losses narrowed compared to the previous year but remained substantial at -356 million RMB. The company’s total assets decreased by nearly 64% to about 903 million RMB. It faces liquidity pressures, with overdue loans and multiple subsidiaries undergoing bankruptcy proceedings, indicating a challenging financial environment and uncertain growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiayu Holding emphasizes its integrated new energy solutions combining high-efficiency PV modules, EPC project management, and innovative solar thermal heating systems tailored for cold regions, offering cost-effective and environmentally friendly energy alternatives. In building decoration, it leverages strong technical expertise and brand reputation to provide customized, energy-saving door and curtain wall systems that meet diverse regional and climatic needs. The company’s comprehensive project management and quality control systems ensure high-quality delivery and customer satisfaction.
